**A new terrain generator, in beta**

Settings ▸ General ▸ New terrain generator (beta) turns on the terrain generator of 1.3 on the Terrain side, beside the one you know, which stays as it is. Its graph ends in one Map Output, as a material ends in Blender, with an input for each thing the map takes: height, water, the colour of the ground, terrains, biomes, climate, layers of rock and masks. Its nodes make what mountain maps are made of — ranges along a crest you draw, peaks you place, volcanoes, mesas, canyons, glacial valleys, coasts and archipelagos — and wear them with erosion, give them a climate and biomes, and lay terrains by slope, height and snow. Live shows the graph on the World side's map as you edit it, the area in view within moments, without writing it; Apply writes it in one step you can undo. Graphs made before open migrated, and five examples give you a start. Graphs are readable JSON documents with a schema and a catalogue, so that a model or a script can write and edit them.
